verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.126
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.126

verses.pali: 13. Kusināravagga
verses.english: 13. Kusinārā

verses.pali: Bharaṇḍukālāmasutta
verses.english: Bharaṇḍu Kālāma

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṁ caramāno yena kapilavatthu tadavasari.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was wandering in the land of the Kosalans when he arrived at Kapilavatthu.

verses.pali: Assosi kho mahānāmo sakko: “bhagavā kira kapilavatthuṁ anuppatto”ti.
verses.english: Mahānāma the Sakyan heard that he had arrived.

verses.pali: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṁ ṭhitaṁ kho mahānāmaṁ sakkaṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: He went up to the Buddha, bowed, and stood to one side. The Buddha said to him,

verses.pali: “Gaccha, mahānāma, kapilavatthusmiṁ, tathārūpaṁ āvasathaṁ jāna yatthajja mayaṁ ekarattiṁ vihareyyāmā”ti.
verses.english: “Go into Kapilavatthu, Mahānāma, and check if there’s a suitable guest house where I can spend the night.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavato paṭissutvā kapilavatthuṁ pavisitvā kevalakappaṁ kapilavatthuṁ anvāhiṇḍanto nāddasa kapilavatthusmiṁ tathārūpaṁ āvasathaṁ yatthajja bhagavā ekarattiṁ vihareyya.
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” replied Mahānāma. He returned to Kapilavatthu and searched all over the city, but he couldn’t see a suitable guest house for the Buddha to spend the night.

verses.pali: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Mahānāma went up to the Buddha, and said to him,

verses.pali: “natthi, bhante, kapilavatthusmiṁ tathārūpo āvasatho yatthajja bhagavā ekarattiṁ vihareyya.
verses.english: “Sir, there’s no suitable guest house in Kapilavatthu for you to spend the night.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhante, bharaṇḍu kālāmo bhagavato purāṇasabrahmacārī.
verses.english: But there is this Bharaṇḍu the Kālāma, who used to be the Buddha’s spiritual companion.

verses.pali: Tassajja bhagavā assame ekarattiṁ viharatū”ti.
verses.english: Why don’t you spend the night at his hermitage?”

verses.pali: “Gaccha, mahānāma, santharaṁ paññāpehī”ti.
verses.english: “Go, Mahānāma, and set out a mat.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavato paṭissutvā yena bharaṇḍussa kālāmassa assamo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā santharaṁ paññāpetvā udakaṁ ṭhapetvā pādānaṁ dhovanāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” replied Mahānāma. He went to Bharaṇḍu’s hermitage, where he set out a mat, and got foot-washing water ready. Then he went back to the Buddha and said to him,

verses.pali: “santhato, bhante, santhāro, udakaṁ ṭhapitaṁ pādānaṁ dhovanāya.
verses.english: “The mat and foot-washing water are set out.

verses.pali: Yassadāni, bhante, bhagavā kālaṁ maññatī”ti.
verses.english: Please, sir, go at your convenience.”

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā yena bharaṇḍussa kālāmassa assamo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
verses.english: Then the Buddha went to Bharaṇḍu’s hermitage, sat down on the seat spread out,

verses.pali: Nisajja kho bhagavā pāde pakkhālesi.
verses.english: and washed his feet.

verses.pali: Atha kho mahānāmassa sakkassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then it occurred to Mahānāma,

verses.pali: “akālo kho ajja bhagavantaṁ payirupāsituṁ.
verses.english: “It’s too late to pay homage to the Buddha today.

verses.pali: Kilanto bhagavā.
verses.english: He’s tired.

verses.pali: Sve dānāhaṁ bhagavantaṁ payirupāsissāmī”ti bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṁ katvā pakkāmi.
verses.english: Tomorrow I’ll pay homage to the Buddha.” He bowed to the Buddha and respectfully circled him, keeping him on his right, then he left.

verses.pali: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko tassā rattiyā accayena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho mahānāmaṁ sakkaṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: Then, when the night had passed, Mahānāma the Sakyan went up to the Buddha, and sat down to one side. The Buddha said to him:

verses.pali: “tayo khome, mahānāma, satthāro santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Mahānāma, there are these three teachers found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame tayo?
verses.english: What three?

verses.pali: Idha, mahānāma, ekacco satthā kāmānaṁ pariññaṁ paññāpeti;
verses.english: One teacher advocates the complete understanding of sensual pleasures,

verses.pali: na rūpānaṁ pariññaṁ paññāpeti, na vedanānaṁ pariññaṁ paññāpeti.
verses.english: but not of forms or feelings.

verses.pali: Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco satthā kāmānaṁ pariññaṁ paññāpeti, rūpānaṁ pariññaṁ paññāpeti;
verses.english: One teacher advocates the complete understanding of sensual pleasures and forms,

verses.pali: na vedanānaṁ pariññaṁ paññāpeti.
verses.english: but not of feelings.

verses.pali: Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco satthā kāmānaṁ pariññaṁ paññāpeti, rūpānaṁ pariññaṁ paññāpeti, vedanānaṁ pariññaṁ paññāpeti.
verses.english: One teacher advocates the complete understanding of sensual pleasures, forms, and feelings.

verses.pali: Ime kho, mahānāma, tayo satthāro santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: These are the three teachers found in the world.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ, mahānāma, tiṇṇaṁ satthārānaṁ ekā niṭṭhā udāhu puthu niṭṭhā”ti?
verses.english: Do these three teachers have the same end or different ends?”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, bharaṇḍu kālāmo mahānāmaṁ sakkaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, Bharaṇḍu said to Mahānāma,

verses.pali: “ekāti, mahānāma, vadehī”ti.
verses.english: “Say they’re the same, Mahānāma!”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, bhagavā mahānāmaṁ sakkaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said,

verses.pali: “nānāti, mahānāma, vadehī”ti.
verses.english: “Say they’re different, Mahānāma!”

verses.pali: Dutiyampi kho bharaṇḍu kālāmo mahānāmaṁ sakkaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: For a second time, Bharaṇḍu said,

verses.pali: “ekāti, mahānāma, vadehī”ti.
verses.english: “Say they’re the same, Mahānāma!”

verses.pali: Dutiyampi kho bhagavā mahānāmaṁ sakkaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said,

verses.pali: “nānāti, mahānāma, vadehī”ti.
verses.english: “Say they’re different, Mahānāma!”

verses.pali: Tatiyampi kho bharaṇḍu kālāmo mahānāmaṁ sakkaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: For a third time, Bharaṇḍu said,

verses.pali: “ekāti, mahānāma, vadehī”ti.
verses.english: “Say they’re the same, Mahānāma!”

verses.pali: Tatiyampi kho bhagavā mahānāmaṁ sakkaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said,

verses.pali: “nānāti, mahānāma, vadehī”ti.
verses.english: “Say they’re different, Mahānāma!”

verses.pali: Atha kho bharaṇḍu kālāmassa etadahosi:
verses.english: Then it occurred to Bharaṇḍu,

verses.pali: “mahesakkhassa vatamhi mahānāmassa sakkassa sammukhā samaṇena gotamena yāvatatiyaṁ apasādito.
verses.english: “The Buddha has rebuked me three times in front of this illustrious Mahānāma.

verses.pali: Yannūnāhaṁ kapilavatthumhā pakkameyyan”ti.
verses.english: Why don’t I leave Kapilavatthu?”

verses.pali: Atha kho bharaṇḍu kālāmo kapilavatthumhā pakkāmi.
verses.english: Then Bharaṇḍu the Kālāma left Kapilavatthu,

verses.pali: Yaṁ kapilavatthumhā pakkāmi tathā pakkantova ahosi na puna paccāgacchīti.
verses.english: never to return.

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
